item.title: Understanding and Managing the Dark Side of Food Tourism
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines negative aspects and challenges associated with food tourism, exploring how these issues can be better managed and mitigated. The call invites research that addresses the darker dimensions of food tourism experiences and their impacts.

Appel publié par Journal of Destination Marketing & Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
